<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 183.045 (likely a sodium adduct, [M+Na]⁺), subtracting the Na⁺ mass (22.989 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 160.056 Da. The formula C₆H₈O₅ matches this mass (exact monoisotopic mass 160.037 Da) within typical ESI‑MS tolerance and is the simplest composition containing only C, H, and O that fits the data. Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C₆H₈O₅.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H8O5</final_answer>
